title: Former UN food agency official claims he was fired for highlighting hunger in Gaza
summary_or_snippet: Benjamin Davis appealing against dismissal from FAO, after being accused by director general of playing 'political games' A former senior UN food agency official has alleged he was fired last week for his work highlighting hunger in Gaza, and has launched an appeal against his dismissal.
